# Reviewer sessions page (cms-admin)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`reviewer`](../../flows/reviewer/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Lets an account with the reviewer settings permission switch the reviewer feature on or off and read the paged log of reviewer sessions (who, when, active or ended).

## Techniques

Server state through the reviewer feature's API context and query keys (`Reviewer.queries`); switching off ends sessions, so the mutation invalidates the log. Paging with `Pagination` + `useClampedPage`; access from `useCallerAccess`.

## Technologies

React 19, TanStack Query (`@tanstack/react-query`), react-hook-form + zod where there is a form, `@abyss/form-commons` components; text from `configs/Copy.constants.ts`.

## Entry points

Route `APP_ROUTES.REVIEWER_SESSIONS` (`/reviewer`); menu item from the views registry, shown for `REVIEWER_SETTINGS_SUBJECT`.

## Where to change what

The route is in `configs/App.routes.ts` and the page is registered in `views/Views.registry.ts`. Text goes in `configs/Copy.constants.ts`, never inline. A component a second page needs moves to `features/` or `components/` (code-standards §4.6).
